name: Matjaž Nemec-After § 42-Am 4
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 42a. Notes that Parliament's estimates for the 2026 budget include the appropriations necessary for the payment of Parliament's share of the budget of the ethics body for 2026; regrets the result of the vote in the Committee on Budgets rejecting the request for transfer of appropriations C2/2025, thereby preventing the payment of Parliament's share to the budget of the ethics body for the year 2025; underscores the importance of respecting the inter-institutional agreement signed on 15 May 2024 for a well-equipped Ethics body able to foster a common culture of ethics and transparency among EU institutions; reiterates Parliament’s commitment to make available the necessary resources to ensure the effective implementation of that agreement and cover any costs arising from Parliament's participation in that agreement.
